fact_checks.quote: We demonstrate that adoption of summer deficit irrigation in alfalfa production can yield large water savings and flexibility to adapt to changing water supplies with minimal on-field economic impact.

fact_checks.quote: Alfalfa grown for forage in the arid Northwest requires 1.8-acre feet to 3.2-acre feet of water per year, depending on length of the growing season.

fact_checks.local_evidence_gap: No local documents on fall irrigation for alfalfa; foreign evidence limited to US arid Northwest annual ranges
